blurb: Guests take a scenic flight over the Pacific Ocean, Downtown San Diego, Imperial Beach, and Coronado Island, then perform a tandem skydive with a 120 MPH free fall followed by a canopy ride. The experience lasts a couple of hours. No prior experience is needed, and expert USPA-certified instructors guide the jump.

quotes.author: Vittorio F.
quotes.text: This was an amazing experience that I had the privilege to share with my two daughters! From the moment we arrived we have been warmly greeted and welcomed by the crew and Andy, the owner, kindly and funnily explained us what would have happened. Flying up was great as we could see the Mexican border, the mountains, downtown San Diego and the ocean before heading back to reach the desired altitude. Adrenaline was at the top and Andy guided me and the jump was amazing. I highly recommend this place if you want to have a one in a lifetime experience. Thank you Andy and to all the team!

quotes.author: Zach J.
quotes.text: Highly recommend this company if you are looking to Skydive in San Diego. Such a professional and fun crew to work with. From check in to leaving, we were all constantly laughing and having fun. To make it even better... this company is affordable. If you can, I would highly recommend to request either Victor or Simeon. They both have such a fun personality and make sure you're always comfortable. If I could, I would bring those guys along with every future skydive I do. Skydiving in San Diego is a must do... but make sure you do it with this company!

quotes.author: Aimee O.
quotes.text: I went here for my first skydive, and it was incredible!!! Our instructors were informative, super chill and friendly. The plane ride shows you around San Diego and you can see part of Mexico, they'll point out what's what. They make sure you're completely and tightly strapped in and let you take over the parachute while you're going down. We got the video and it was totally worth every penny. Probably won't get it again for the next time though. Thank you to everyone here for making our experience so memorable and fun!!! Completely recommend!

quotes.author: Gabe Stover
quotes.text: Fantastic time! They're definitely making me want to get certified for solo jumps. Highly recommend to anyone who's interested in skydiving. Just an FYI, it's 2 people at a time, due to the size of the planes. So if you book with more than 2 people, you get to watch your other friends on their way down. I cannot recommend this place enough. I've done 3 jumps in total, but this was my first time here. I'll 100% be booking here again, over other options up north. If you're considering booking, just do it. You won't regret it!

quotes.author: Yuliana A.
quotes.text: Came in yesterday very anxious but the staff made me feel so comfortable right away! Everything from the check-in, all the way to the landing was super easy and I couldn't have asked for a better first experience. Dylan was great at cracking jokes to calm the nerves and answered all 100 of my questions with no hesitation. I even got my photos and video back the same day! I would recommend this place to anyone considering skydiving. I will definitely be back. Thank you so much again for my making my birthday unforgettable!!

quotes.author: Jim V.
quotes.text: This is the 2nd year in a row that I jumped with Pacific Coast and it was amazing. Everyone was friendly, helpful and just made it fun. They spend plenty of time making sure you know what to expect, and the jump crew is world class! I jumped with Sim both times and he makes it fun too! The view to the drop zone was 2nd to none with Mexico on the left side of the plane and the San Diego skyline on the right.
